duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa illam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana bada idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
